text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This framework helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key checkpoints along the way, and deliverables, the concrete results you promise to produce. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters a lot. Everyone involved should understand and agree on the goals from the start. When all these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly and teams are more likely to achieve what they set out to do.
